chain.label: FAA inspection standards for former military turbine rotorcraft inadequate
chain.trigger: FAA allowed former military turbine-powered rotorcraft to be inspected under Part 43 Appendix D

chain.label: FAA failed to require routine surveillance of experimental exhibition operators
chain.trigger: FAA Order 8900.1 did not include a requirement for inspectors to perform routine surveillance of operators with experimental exhibition airworthiness certificates

chain.label: Operator inspected/maintained helicopter only to minimum standards instead of more rigorous standards previously available
chain.trigger: the probable cause was the operator's failure to adequately inspect the former military turbine-powered helicopter

caused_by.evidence: MARPAT Aviation performed inspections of the helicopter according to the generic inspection criteria for aircraft systems and components in Appendix D to 14 CFR Part 43, as required
the FAA's inadequate oversight of the operator, which did not detect the inherent risk associated with the operation

chain.label: Undetected fatigue cracking of exhaust diffuser spot welds and corrosion-separated rear bearing cover outer flange
chain.trigger: the rear bearing cover showed a pre-existing separation in the outer flange due to wall thinning from corrosion; fatigue regions at the spot welds...were consistent with stable fatigue crack growth

caused_by.evidence: the operator's failure to inspect the engine using more frequent inspection intervals and more rigorous standards readily available to the operator resulted in missed opportunities to potentially detect engine problems

chain.label: Exhaust diffuser cracking and bearing cover separation caused power turbine shaft misalignment culminating in No. 2 bearing failure
chain.trigger: reduced load transfer led to increased stresses at the inner strut support attachments, resulting in cracks...causing a misalignment in the power turbine shaft

caused_by.evidence: the loss of engine power resulted from the failure of the No. 2 bearing; that failure occurred because of degraded radial support for the power turbine shaft at the No. 3 and No. 4 bearings due to cracks in the exhaust diffuser and a separation of the rear bearing cover outer flange

chain.label: Loss of engine power in flight
chain.trigger: a partial or total loss of engine power occurred before impact

caused_by.evidence: the loss of engine power resulted from the failure of the No. 2 bearing

chain.label: Helicopter struck two powerlines during forced-landing autorotation
chain.trigger: the helicopter contacted powerlines during the forced landing

caused_by.evidence: the loss of engine power...required an emergency autorotation and a forced landing...the helicopter contacted powerlines during the forced landing

chain.label: Loss of control after powerline strike
chain.trigger: which resulted in a loss of control

caused_by.evidence: the helicopter contacted powerlines during the forced landing, which resulted in a loss of control

chain.label: Helicopter impacted rock face, road, and guardrail
chain.trigger: the helicopter subsequently impacted the rock face, road, and guardrail near the bottom of the rock face

caused_by.evidence: the helicopter subsequently impacted the rock face, road, and guardrail near the bottom of the rock face

chain.label: Fatal blunt-force and thermal injuries to all six occupants; postcrash fire
chain.trigger: the guardrail impact likely caused the fuel tanks to rupture, which led to the postcrash fire

caused_by.evidence: their cause of death was also blunt force and thermal injuries. The accident was not survivable.
